name: Swiss Cheese
siboNotes: Hard aged cheeses like Swiss are naturally low in lactose and well-tolerated during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Choose aged Swiss varieties for lowest lactose content
Store properly wrapped to maintain freshness and prevent mold
Allow to come to room temperature before serving for best flavor
Shred fresh rather than buying pre-shredded for better taste
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of calcium for bone health
Contains beneficial probiotics from aging process
